commits.step: registered local perturbations, WM cooperation gate, explicit charged all8 bridge
57 CPU contracts and idempotent completed spot-check resolution

receipt_commit: The subsequent commit adding this file; find with git log -1 -- T2G_READY.json

implementation.default: OFF: no source iteration, model calls, file reads/writes or physics dispatch
implementation.source: Identity-checked in-memory all8/per_seed_v1 confirmation; only admitted cooperative examples from the requested arm's own bank
implementation.parameters: Caller supplies source-plan onset_s, hold_s and depth labels, e.g. from moves.from_plan; source labels and perturbations must lie within registered variety windows
implementation.perturbation: Uniform local onset/hold/depth draws within parameter_fraction times each registered range, intersected with that range; time-warp and depth-scale the verified effective residual; retain full source plan duration
implementation.partners: At most one non-ego partner replaced by a visible same-lane CAV; 2..4 members including ego; t-1 timestamps required; HDVs excluded
implementation.execution: Recipient's own MAPPO trajectory plus residual, through existing centre_feasibility/build_plan bounds and allowed-speed clamp; policy duplicates and zero residuals discarded
implementation.wm_gate: Paired full registered horizon costs for base, group and every member-only solo; retain strictly positive expected base-minus-group gain and best-solo-minus-group synergy; missing/nonfinite/wrong-size sample arrays rejected
implementation.fairness: Identical function, configuration, sampling, WM screening and spot-check selection for B and R; each arm must provide its own confirmation records
implementation.spot_checks: ceil(registered fraction * WM-kept examples), selected without replacement using an independent RNG stream; pending checks withheld from training; failed checks dropped; accepted results preserve each own-seed plan/tape label
implementation.deduplication: Deterministic physical-profile/member/source/seed identity within a batch; repeated completed receipt resolution does not call the checker again
implementation.provenance: Serializable digest-protected batch receipt, source confirmation hash, source example/seed/plan, perturbed labels, WM gain/synergy and verification status

api.config(raw=None): Resolve and validate explicitly registered settings; returns None when off
api.augment(sources, *, arm, registration=No: Pure CPU preparation returning examples, pending spot_checks, counts, resolved registration and receipt_sha256
api.resolve_spot_checks(batch, checker): Explicit callback resolution; accepts only matching-plan admitted cooperative examples from sealed same-arm all8 records; returns a new batch
api.spot_check_quote(request, t0): Existing verify_perseed.quote_decision conservative quote including both seeds, later-harm windows and all solos
api.verify_all8(request, *, snapshot, root,: Explicit later-run adapter to verify_perseed._verify and confirm_all8; existing health/admission/charge hooks and measured later harm on both seeds; never invoked by augment

source_contract.confirmation: In-memory record with confirmation_sha256, verify_mode=all8_both_seeds, bank_rule=per_seed_v1, arm, t0 and per_seed_v1.examples
source_contract.example_index: Index of admitted/cooperative example with plan, seed_index and existing verified profile/perturbation_profile

context.ego_id: Acting CAV, included in source members
context.rows: Only own sensing/V2V view; whitelist vid, is_cav, s_m, v_mps, lane, allowed_speed_mps, observed_at_s; observed_at_s <= t_s - 1
context.policy_traj: Mapping of each visible CAV to its own finite source-policy acceleration trajectory, at least source duration; source-member centre identity checked

registered_config_keys.parameter_fraction: Explicit positive fraction <= 1 of registered window widths; register a small radius for the run
registered_config_keys.horizon_s: Full registered look-ahead; passed unchanged to scorer; must cover source duration
registered_config_keys.bounds: Existing ordered plant acceleration bounds, upper cap <= 1.2 m/s^2
registered_config_keys.variety: Existing variety.VARIETY_REGISTERED keys only; inherits its onset/hold/depth windows

scorer_contract.coupling: Same local belief state, sample worlds, full look-ahead and MAPPO continuation for base/group/solos
scorer_contract.inputs: Sanitized local observable context and executable plans only; source verification outcomes and unrelated context/row fields are not forwarded

integration_requirements_for_T2C: Call augment for B and R under identical registered settings, each with its own sealed in-memory bank confirmations and observable source contexts.
Provide source onset/hold/depth labels and a belief-only WM cost callback preserving paired worlds and the full registered look-ahead.
Consume examples as augmented plan targets/states; do not consume pending spot_checks as training examples.

Before later physics, quote and register the all8 budget, bind each request to its source's OWN snapshot/seed/actor and the single ledger, then explicitly call resolve_spot_checks with verify_all8 bound to those runtime arguments.
For all8-accepted examples use verified_example's OWN per-seed tape/plan rather than inheriting another seed's labels. WM-only examples remain explicitly unverified.
Persist the returned batch as the augmented-examples component receipt in the end-to-end smoke. This task does not modify the shared rerun integration module.

results.total: 124 passed across the four completed suites

iteration_notes: Two combined-suite attempts exceeded the 120-second terminal timeout; process inspection confirmed no matching test process remained before retrying individually.

An added partner-policy assertion initially ignored the inherited allowed-speed clamp; corrected the test to assert own-policy acceleration until the ceiling and zero afterward. All final suites pass.

readiness_scope: Dry CPU implementation and integration API ready; real WM checkpoint scoring, charged SUMO spot checks and the cross-track end-to-end smoke are later registered runtime work.
